t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The best thing to try and do is alternate between gnomes, as that reduced the amount of 0s

vb_textbox.text: The advice I received was to alternate between gnomes, but after a while I found this didn't really make a difference. What worked for me best was to choose one gnome twice, then the other twice, then the other once, then the other once. In that pattern, it definitely limited the amount of 0s I was getting
